items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, Richard Davis played mostly, as I can recall. ... I did three records for Atlantic.

ctx.x: And then Richard Davis on the other session. This was the first session.

Yeah, Richard Davis played mostly, as I can recall. And then Ron Carter played on some of that stuff. He played on Laws’ Cause. Yeah, that’s who played on the last. I did three records for Atlantic. I did four altogether, but I did the fourth after I had already signed with CTI.

It’s here on Flute By-Laws that we see Mean Lean. As we talked off-mic, this is the first time I see it show up in your discography, but then it’s on In the Beginning, and then it reappears on Storm, then the Calm. So it seems to keep coming back into your repertoire. Do you want to talk about this particular composition?
